title: Wheat imports by supplier and domestic wheat production, 2010–2024
publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)

tradeFlags.I: Value imputed by a receiving agency

productionFlags.I: Value imputed by a receiving agency

geography.method: Match exact reported M49 codes to the retained UN M49/ISO3 table and the existing map polygons. Keep unmatched and historical areas available by their original names.

interpretation: Each bilateral row is an import-side quantity for a named FAO reporter and partner. FAO can use partner information for missing reports. Preserve A, E, I and X as the publisher defines them.

Totals in the explorer sum numeric quantities for included partners. World or regional aggregates, self-partner rows and export-side counterparts are excluded from that sum. The source has no separate World-partner quantity for this subset.
An absent relationship or year has no observation. A source-reported zero retains its value and flag. Supplier connections refer to customs partners and do not describe physical travel routes.

Domestic wheat production is the separate QCL production series. Keep its source flags and notes, including missing values. It describes harvested output and can be compared with trade only for the same reporting area and year.
